observations: The page number «19» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. At the foot, the signature «3*» on the right. L01-L31 continue chapter 25, begun on p. 18 (JP2 0050, L24-L26).
L17: the vertical bar between «elgeib» and «quartum» marks the beginning of fol. 130 verso of O, which the note in the right margin, «O 130v», names; transcribed as a margin note.

L06-L17: the ascension of a sign in the right sphere: the sine of the obliquity, 23° 51′ (elgeib primum), the sine of its complement (secundum), the sine of the declination of the last degree of the sign (tertium) and the sine of its complement (quartum); the third times the second, divided by the first, times sixty, divided by the fourth, is the sine of the ascension, whose arc is taken. Checked: this is 60 sin δ cos ε / (sin ε cos δ) = 60 tan δ / tan ε, the sine of the right ascension α for a radius of sixty, since tan δ = tan ε sin α. L20-L27: the ascensions of Taurus and Gemini are found by subtracting those of the signs before them; Pisces, Libra and Virgo share the ascension of Aries, Leo, Scorpio and Aquarius that of Taurus, Cancer, Capricorn and Sagittarius that of Gemini.

L06 and L30: the note numbers 7 and 28 are printed after the comma that follows the word, with a space before them, «ortus, 7)» and «elmustakim, 28)»; transcribed as printed. L11: «qnaestione», see the critical note. L08: «elmeil», the declination (al-mail), here the obliquity; L28 and L30 «elfelek elmustakim», the right sphere.

N01: the note ends with the dash, without a full stop after «differre»; N08: «O —» and «C —», without a point after the sigla. N03: before the dash after «O.» a light vertical stroke (darkest pixel 153), probably a spacing sort; not transcribed. N11: «habet (?)», the bracket 10 px from the word, a thin space.
The colons and semicolons of the text and the apparatus stand after the thin space of the edition (9-13 px measured).
